  • Method Details

    • id

      public Heading.Builder id(String id)
      The anchor of this heading: what a table of contents links to, and what a section around it is named by. An address, so no whitespace may be in it — an attribute takes the first word and what follows becomes something nobody meant. What it is made of otherwise is the author's: a slug, a number, a word in their own language.

    • href

      public Heading.Builder href(String href)
      Heading as a link (hN > a). The address is the consumer's, and it is kept trimmed. A scheme that executes rather than navigates is refused here — javascript:, data:, vbscript:, however they are spelled: a browser drops spaces, tabs and control characters before it reads a scheme, so java\tscript: is refused with the plain spelling. An href is the last place any of them can be stopped before the page.

    • rel

      public Heading.Builder rel(Rel... values)
      What the link says about itself: rel(NOFOLLOW) for an address the page does not vouch for, rel(UGC) for one a visitor wrote. Repetitions collapse, order is kept.

    • newTab

      public Heading.Builder newTab()
      Open in a new tab. noopener comes with it and cannot be forgotten: without it the opened page can reach back into this one through window.opener, and remembering that by hand at every link is exactly the kind of vigilance the kit exists to remove.

    • lang
